description: EUROCONTROL Data Snapshot 39, published on 7 February 2023, summarises the ransomware attacks on aviation organisations that its European Air Traffic Management Computer Emergency Response Team (EATM-CERT) recorded, to show how criminal groups target the aviation supply chain. Coverage: incidents reported in Europe in 2021 and 2022 by quarter, drawn from EATM-CERT data with global data from stakeholders worldwide; 73 ransomware attacks were reported in Europe in 2022, fewer than in 2021, and worldwide about 2.5 ransomware attacks a week hit aviation-related organisations. Original equipment manufacturers were the majority of victims, and attackers use 'big game hunting' with ransom demands around 5% of annual revenue. Format and access: a two-page PDF (347 KB) with charts, free on the EUROCONTROL site. Licence and cost: free to read; no licence is stated. Caveats: aggregate counts only, no incident list, and a one-off snapshot, not a maintained series. The counts and target mix can set attack frequencies and the share of supply chain targets in cyber hazard exposure and resilience models of air navigation and airport systems. It relates to the EUROCONTROL aviation intelligence portal and the Singapore Cyber Landscape report in the catalogue.
